aboutData.heading: Who We Are

images.alt: Close-up of our technician using a squeegee on a window
Two professionals collaborating to clean large panes

paragraphs: At Viking Window Washing, we have proudly served numerous homeowners and businesses, delivering consistently streak-free results. Our trained staff utilizes modern tools and proven methods to restore brightness and clarity to every window.
From expansive residences to cozy condominiums, our commitment remains the same—exceptional care for each window and unwavering respect for our clients’ property.

pricingData.heading: Window Cost Calculator
pricingData.minimumFeeNote: Use our quick estimator to get an approximate cost based on window count. Keep in mind our minimum service fee is always $100.

items.question: Which regions do you service?
items.answer: We serve Meridian, Idaho, as well as nearby suburbs. Not sure if we can reach you? Just ask!

items.question: What times are you available?
items.answer: We operate from 8 AM to 6 PM on weekdays, with weekend appointments by arrangement.

items.question: Do you guarantee streak-free windows?
items.answer: We do! If you notice any streaks or spots after we leave, let us know and we'll come back to fix them.

items.question: Are your cleaning supplies eco-friendly?
items.answer: Yes, we use non-toxic, environmentally conscious products that are safe for your family and pets.

items.question: Is there a minimum size for a job?
items.answer: All jobs are welcome, but note our minimum service fee of $100.

items.question: How far in advance should I schedule?
items.answer: One to two weeks’ notice is ideal, but we do our best to fit in last-minute requests when possible.
